card.name: Digits inside phone numbers and coordinates
card.fires_on: Single digits at the start or middle of a number, mostly the 2, 0 or 5 in phone numbers such as 207 area codes, and in map coordinates. It also fires weakly on Aryan/Airya name pieces.

modes.label: Phone number digits
modes.description: A digit within a US phone number, especially the 2 or 0 of the 207 area code.
modes.example: contact: Hazardous Waste Staff Augusta Office 207-287-2651 Bangor Office 2<<0>>7-941-45

modes.label: Coordinate or date digits
modes.description: The leading digit of a degree figure or an ordinal century number.
modes.example: El Chico National Park located near Pachuca City, Hidalgo, Mexico (98°42'33''W, <<2>>0°11'22''

modes.label: Aryan name pieces
modes.description: A start of the Iranian ethnic name Arya or Avestan abbreviations.
